The full record isfree with an accountor through the [API](https://indexed.vc/docs/api). ## About Vectary is a browser-based, no-code 3D and AR design platform that lets teams create interactive product configurators, assembly manuals, and immersive presentations without downloads or programming knowledge. Designers, engineers, product managers, and marketers use Vectary to model, import, edit, collaborate, and publish 3D content in one workflow. The platform is trusted by more than 4 million users worldwide, spanning industries such as automotive, consumer goods, manufacturing, electronics, and furniture. Summary It lists 11–50 employees. It has raised $14.4M in total across 3 rounds, most recently a $4.6M Venture Round in Jan 2023. Investors include BlueYard Capital and EQT Ventures.
